prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body dual-body portrait: left leg tier L0, right leg tier L0, collarbone boundary. ONE woman standing, angled 45 degrees toward the camera, the camera set back so her whole body fits in the frame from the top of her head to her feet, her face still sharp. Mid 20s.

Subject: A real photograph of a strikingly beautiful adult Japanese woman in age-gyaru makeup — luminous glossy skin with a bright highlighter, thick black eyeliner, extremely long dramatic false lashes top and bottom, large eyes with bright real catchlights, glossy peach-pink lips, towering teased bleached-blonde hair, a confident sparkling expression. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living flesh with real pores and fine skin grain, real living eyes with bright catchlights and genuine depth, individual hair strands catching the light — a photograph of a real face, not an illustration, not a render, not cel-shaded. On each ear a large gold chandelier-shaped hoop.

Physique: A towering hourglass woman of extraordinary volume standing tall on long legs, never short or squat. A colossal heavy chest wider than her shoulders, a waistline that still pulls in sharply even at this size, then an enormous belly of massive rounded folds and colossal wide hips flaring out again, her left leg entirely — thigh, knee, calf, ankle and foot — is part of the vessel above, ending in a glass sandal; her right leg entirely — thigh, knee, calf, ankle and foot — is part of the vessel above, ending in a glass sandal.

Material body: below the collarbones — her whole chest, both arms, both hands, belly, hips, her left leg entirely — thigh, knee, calf, ankle and foot — is part of the vessel above, ending in a glass sandal, and her right leg entirely — thigh, knee, calf, ankle and foot — is part of the vessel above, ending in a glass sandal — is a sculpted vessel of thick, crystal-clear glass. The vessel is completely filled with clear jade-green water from the collarbone line down through whichever leg parts remain part of the vessel, with no hollow space and no air gap anywhere inside it. The glass is unmistakably glass: thick, crystal-clear and polished, with bright specular reflections sliding along every curved surface, sharp white highlights and dark refraction edges where the walls are thickest, tiny bubbles trapped in the glass itself. Both arms below the shoulder, both hands, and every finger and knuckle, are the same solid clear glass as the rest of the vessel, with no skin anywhere on them. Small bright fish and slow-drifting water plants move freely through the whole filled volume — passing beside and between both hands and every finger, rising through her whole chest up to the collarbone line itself, winding around both hips, and drifting through whichever thigh and leg sections remain glass, never crowding, always with open water around each one.

Boundary: a single straight, flat line runs around the base of her neck and across both collarbones, never jagged, never zigzag — real skin above, material immediately below, no skin anywhere lower. At that line, the material's edge rises in a small raised step above her flesh, casting a crisp shadow.

Both legs stay entirely glass to their glass sandals — no transition.

Both feet: her left foot stands in a matching glass sandal, carved from the same clear material; her right foot stands in a matching glass sandal, carved from the same clear material.

Setting: a huge backdrop behind her washed with two coloured lights from behind — a soft aqua teal on one side and a pale silver-white on the other, blending into a smooth gradient in the middle — glowing evenly, marked with a few thin dark vertical lines spaced evenly across it so the bending of those lines inside her material body is unmistakable, and a glossy dark floor beneath her feet.

Pose: standing tall, body angled 45 degrees, feet planted apart, her left hand (solid glass) resting on her flared hip, her right arm held clear of her body with the hand (solid glass) relaxed at hip height, both hands well away from her face, head tilted slightly toward the camera.

Lighting: the glowing backdrop floods her material body from behind, so teal light passes through one side and silver-white light passes through the other, the vertical lines clearly visible bending inside the glass. A soft frontal light falls on her face, ears and any real leg parts. A thin cool rim light traces her whole figure. shot on a Hasselblad X2D with an 85mm lens, shallow depth of field. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
